haiku.problem: The question says Jesus told Nathanael alone, but verse 51 has Jesus address the group with "you will all see." It also doesn't say the Son of Man is Jesus, so a baker who doesn't know the title may be confused.

Coverage: the card "When Jesus finds Philip, He tells Philip to follow Him" (2-2) is a central call and matches the title, "Jesus Calls His First Disciples," but no trivia question covers it. It is more important than the Cephas name question.
